issues.display_title: Issue #577: Get Virtual Tours GoThru Integration
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Get Virtual Tours GoThru Integration

Summary

Implemented requestor capabilities in Panorra API to securely fetch user virtual tours from the GoThru API provider via Keycloak service account authentication (client_credentials grant), adhering to Epic #9 and Issue #11.

Files Created & Updated

1. Configuration & Models

  • src/Config/Connection.go:
    • Added Keycloak environment variables: KeycloakBaseURL, KeycloakRealm, KeycloakClientID, KeycloakClientSecret.
    • Added GoThru API provider variable: GoThruAPIBaseURL.
    • Added fallback aliases (KEYCLOAK_URL -> KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL, API_GOTHRU -> GOTHRU_API_BASE_URL).
    • Added trailing-slash sanitization via strings.TrimRight.
  • src/Models/UserKeycloakLink.go:
    • Created GORM model UserKeycloakLink for table public.user_keycloak_link.
    • Fields: id (int64/INT8), local_user_id (uuid.UUID), keycloak_sub, keycloak_username, keycloak_email, realm_name, migration_batch_id, link_status, linked_at, notes, created_at, updated_at.
  • src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go:
    • Created DTOs: KeycloakTokenResponse, GoThruVirtualTour, GoThruPagination, GoThruVirtualToursResponse.
    • Defined GoThruVirtualTour as a flexible map[string]interface{} alias to safely handle dynamic MySQL/PHP PDO column types (e.g. api_key_id returned as string, numeric fields, nulls) without JSON unmarshaling type mismatches.

2. Services & HTTP Clients

  • src/Utils/Keycloak/Keycloak.go:
    • Implemented GetServiceToken() with thread-safe double-check locking (sync.Mutex).
    • Implemented fetchServiceToken() hitting Keycloak's token endpoint with grant_type=client_credentials.
    • Added pre-flight validation for required environment variables (KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET).
    • Caches token in-memory and refreshes 60 seconds before expiration (safetyWindow).
    • Logs exact Keycloak response body on errors for clear operational debugging without exposing secrets.
  • src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru.go:
    • Implemented FetchVirtualTours(keycloakUUID, search, page, perPage).
    • Injects Authorization: Bearer <keycloak_token>, X-Requestor-App: panorra, and Accept: application/json.
    • Calls GET {GOTHRU_API_BASE_URL}/internal/users/{keycloak_sub}/virtual-tours.
    • Detailed error logging: logs provider response body on 403 Forbidden to quickly diagnose permission issues.
    • Maps provider HTTP status codes (401, 403, 400, 5xx) to ProviderError.

3. Action, Controller, & Routes

  • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours.go:
    • Implemented GetVirtualTours(c *fiber.Ctx) handler.
    • Extracts authenticated user's local_user_id from c.Locals("userId").
    • Resolves user's keycloak_sub from user_keycloak_link table via ResolveKeycloakSub(userId).
    • Returns HTTP 404 if the user has no linked Keycloak account.
    • Calls GoThru.FetchVirtualTours(keycloakSub, search, page, perPage).
    • Maps provider errors: 401/403/5xx -> 502 Bad Gateway; 400 -> 400 Bad Request.
    • Returns normalized HTTP 200 JSON envelope with data array and pagination metadata.
  • src/Controllers/V1/GoThruIntegrationControllers.go:
    • Created controller GetGoThruVirtualTours delegating to Action handler.
  • src/Routes/V1/GoThruIntegrationRoutes.go:
    • Registered GET /gothru/virtual-tours with controller handler.
  • src/Routes/V1/Routes.go:
    • Wired registerGoThruIntegrationRoutes(http) into main routing setup.

4. API Collection

  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/folder.yml: Created folder definition (seq: 17).
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/Get Virtual Tours.yml: Added request definition with query parameters (search, page, per_page), headers, and examples (200 - Tours Found, 200 - Empty Tours, 401 - Unauthorized).

5. Unit Tests

  • src/Utils/Keycloak/Keycloak_test.go:
    • TestGetServiceToken_SuccessAndCaching: Tests fetching token and verifies caching prevents redundant network calls.
    • TestGetServiceToken_KeycloakError: Tests error handling when Keycloak rejects credentials.
  • src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru_test.go:
    • TestFetchVirtualTours_Success: Tests successful response parsing with query params.
    • TestFetchVirtualTours_EmptyData: Tests handling of empty tour arrays.
    • TestFetchVirtualTours_ProviderErrors: Tests 401, 403, and 400 provider error mapping.
  • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours_test.go:
    • TestGetVirtualTours_Unauthorized_NoUserId: Tests rejection when user session is missing.
    • TestGetVirtualTours_KeycloakNotLinked: Tests 404 response when user is not linked in user_keycloak_link.
    • TestGetVirtualTours_Success: Tests end-to-end handler response normalization and confirms keycloak_sub is passed in URL path.
    • TestGetVirtualTours_ProviderFailure_ReturnsBadGateway: Tests safe 502 error mapping on provider auth failures.

Verification

# Run newly created integration tests
go test -v ./src/Utils/Keycloak/... ./src/Utils/GoThru/... ./src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/...

# Run all project tests
go test ./...

# Verify compilation
go build ./...

Results:

  • All tests in src/Utils/Keycloak, src/Utils/GoThru, and src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration passed (0 failures).
  • All package tests across the entire repository passed.
  • go build ./... compiled cleanly with 0 errors.

API Usage & Examples (Frontend Guide)

Endpoint

GET /gothru/virtual-tours

Frontend simply calls this Panorra endpoint with the standard Panorra user Bearer token. Frontend does not need to send user_id or deal with Keycloak/GoThru directly.

Headers

Authorization: Bearer <panorra_token>
Accept: application/json

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
search string No - Filter by tour name (tour_name) or tour key (tour_key)
page int No 1 Page number (min: 1)
per_page int No 20 Number of items per page (min: 1, max: 100)

Request Examples

1. Default (Page 1, 20 items)

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/gothru/virtual-tours" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <panorra_user_token>" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

2. With Search and Pagination

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/gothru/virtual-tours?search=Gym&page=2&per_page=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <panorra_user_token>" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

Response Examples

1. 200 OK — Tours Found

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": [
    {
      "tour_id": 820508,
      "cdn": "0",
      "tour_key": "u1NXOiVK",
      "1_cid": "583554146763372625",
      "moderation_id": 3591071,
      "tour_name": "Gym Fit Forme",
      "creation_date": "2026-09-28 05:00:05",
      "last_update": "2026-09-28 05:00:05",
      "lat": "45.6466825",
      "lng": "-73.5684739",
      "vr": "1",
      "deactivated": "0"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total_pages": 1
  }
}

2. 200 OK — No Tours / Empty State

Note: This is a valid empty state, not an error. Display a user-friendly empty state in the UI.

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": [],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 0,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total_pages": 0
  }
}

3. 404 Not Found — Account Not Linked to GoThru

User has no entry in the user_keycloak_link table.

{
  "statusCode": 404,
  "data": {
    "message": "Keycloak account is not linked for this user"
  }
}

4. 401 Unauthorized — Session Expired / Invalid Token

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "message": "Unauthorized"
  }
}

5. 502 Bad Gateway — GoThru Service Down or Unreachable

{
  "statusCode": 502,
  "data": {
    "message": "Unable to connect to GoThru service"
  }
}

Problem

In cross-app data exchange between GoThru ecosystem applications (Epic #9, Issue #11), Panorra users need to view and select their virtual tours hosted on GoThru (such as Tourmkr) directly from Panorra without signing into GoThru separately or exposing internal service credentials to the frontend.

Panorra backend acts as the requestor backend. It must obtain a Keycloak service account token using client_credentials, query the local user_keycloak_link table to resolve the authenticated user's Keycloak UUID (keycloak_sub), securely call GoThru API's provider endpoint GET /internal/users/{keycloak_sub}/virtual-tours, normalize the response, and return it to the Panorra frontend.

Scope

  • Configuration: Add Keycloak and GoThru provider environment variables in src/Config/Connection.go:
    • KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL (with KEYCLOAK_URL fallback)
    • KEYCLOAK_REALM (default: "gothru")
    • KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID
    • KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET
    • GOTHRU_API_BASE_URL (with API_GOTHRU fallback)
  • Database Model: Create UserKeycloakLink in src/Models/UserKeycloakLink.go matching public.user_keycloak_link:
    • Table name: user_keycloak_link
    • Columns: id (int64/INT8), local_user_id (UUID), keycloak_sub, keycloak_username, keycloak_email, realm_name, migration_batch_id, link_status, linked_at, notes, created_at, updated_at.
  • DTOs: Create GoThruVirtualTour (flexible map alias for dynamic MySQL/PDO serialization), GoThruPagination, GoThruVirtualToursResponse, and KeycloakTokenResponse in src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go.
  • Keycloak Token Service: Implement src/Utils/Keycloak/Keycloak.go:
    • POST to {KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL}/realms/{KEYCLOAK_REALM}/protocol/openid-connect/token with grant_type=client_credentials.
    • In-memory thread-safe token caching with double-check locking (sync.Mutex).
    • Automatic refresh 60 seconds before expiry (safetyWindow).
    • Never log access tokens or client secrets.
  • GoThru HTTP Client: Implement src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru.go:
    • Calls GET {GOTHRU_API_BASE_URL}/internal/users/{keycloak_sub}/virtual-tours.
    • Injects Authorization: Bearer <keycloak_service_token>.
    • Sets X-Requestor-App: panorra and Accept: application/json.
    • Supports query parameters: search, page, and per_page.
    • Maps 401/403/400/5xx errors cleanly via ProviderError.
  • Action Handler: Implement src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours.go:
    • Reads authenticated userId (Panorra's local_user_id) from c.Locals("userId").
    • Resolves keycloak_sub from user_keycloak_link table via ResolveKeycloakSub(userId).
    • Returns HTTP 404 with "Keycloak account is not linked for this user" if the link record is missing.
    • Calls GoThru.FetchVirtualTours(keycloakSub, search, page, perPage).
    • Forwards search, page, and per_page query parameters.
    • Maps provider 401/403/5xx to HTTP 502 Bad Gateway without leaking internal details.
    • Maps provider 400 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
    • Returns HTTP 200 with normalized tours data and pagination envelope.
    • Treats empty tour arrays [] as valid empty states (non-error).
  • Controller & Routes:
    • Create controller in src/Controllers/V1/GoThruIntegrationControllers.go.
    • Register route GET /gothru/virtual-tours in src/Routes/V1/GoThruIntegrationRoutes.go and src/Routes/V1/Routes.go.
  • Testing:
    • Unit tests for Keycloak token fetcher and cache in src/Utils/Keycloak/Keycloak_test.go.
    • Unit tests for GoThru provider client in src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru_test.go.
    • Unit tests for action handler in src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours_test.go (unauthorized, unlinked user, success with keycloak_sub, provider failure).
  • API Collection:
    • Create collection folder in api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/folder.yml.
    • Create request documentation in api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/Get Virtual Tours.yml.

Behavior Boundary

  • Endpoint is read-only.
  • Requires Panorra authenticated user session (c.Locals("userId")). Unauthenticated requests return 401 Unauthorized.
  • Looks up user's keycloak_sub from user_keycloak_link based on Panorra's local_user_id. Unlinked users return 404 Not Found.
  • Provider route receives the user's keycloak_sub as the user identifier in the URL path.
  • Provider response 200 [] returns HTTP 200 with data: [] and pagination total: 0.
  • Response format:
{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": [
    {
      "tour_id": 820508,
      "tour_key": "u1NXOiVK",
      "tour_name": "Gym Fit Forme",
      "creation_date": "2026-09-28 05:00:05",
      "last_update": "2026-09-28 05:00:05",
      "lat": "45.6466825",
      "lng": "-73.5684739",
      "vr": "1"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total_pages": 1
  }
}

Out of Scope

  • Modifying existing database schema or creating migrations.
  • Modifying GoThru API provider internal endpoints.
  • Storing or exposing Keycloak service account credentials in frontend code.
  • Committing or pushing Git changes directly.

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /gothru/virtual-tours is registered and accessible with authenticated Panorra JWT.
  • Keycloak service account token is fetched via client_credentials and cached in-memory with automatic pre-expiry refresh.
  • GoThru provider endpoint is invoked with Authorization: Bearer <keycloak_token> and X-Requestor-App: panorra.
  • Empty arrays from GoThru provider return HTTP 200 with empty data array and total 0.
  • Provider errors (401, 403, 5xx) return controlled HTTP 502 Bad Gateway without leaking tokens.
  • All unit tests pass (go test ./...) with zero failures.
  • Project compiles cleanly (go build ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-10-01.
